title: BONES | A structure for living
label: Free · No ads · Every claim graded
desc: A free library for understanding your body and the universe it lives in. Plain language first, and every claim graded so you know how much to trust it.

title: Fuel | BONES
label: Body · Fuel pillar
desc: Food, from three million years of evolution to the label on the box: history, shopping, each macronutrient, and myths graded by evidence.

title: Move | BONES
label: Body · Move pillar
desc: How little exercise you need, why bones want weight, four lifts from no equipment to a barbell, walking, mobility and how primates move, with every claim graded by evidence.

title: Staying Put | BONES
label: Being human · Chapter 4
desc: About 12,000 years ago some of us stopped following our food and started growing it. How farming reshaped our bodies, and how our skeletons kept the record.

title: Other Senses | BONES
label: Book companion · An Immense World
desc: You see only the slice of the world your eyes, ears, nose and skin can pick up. A walk through how other animals sense it, after Ed Yong's An Immense World.

title: The Shrinking Jaw | BONES
label: Evolution · Draft
desc: Over two million years our ancestors found ways to chew less, and each step left the face a little smaller. Part of why so many people today have crowded teeth.

title: The Slow Handover | BONES
label: Thinking · Draft
desc: The AI risk most likely to catch us isn't a robot uprising. It's a long series of sensible decisions, each handing a little more of the wheel to machines.

title: Everything, by size | BONES
label: Science exhibit
desc: Zoom from one atom to the observable universe, and find each BONES page at the size it lives at.

title: Event Horizon | BONES
label: Science exhibit · Black holes
desc: A black hole drawn live from Einstein's equations. Every pixel follows its own ray of light back through curved spacetime, plus hands-on relativity labs.

title: The Handedness Book | BONES
label: Science exhibit · Chemistry
desc: Why left and right molecules matter, told with hands, keys and germs.

title: Bennu Sample Files | BONES
label: Science exhibit · Asteroid Bennu
desc: In 2023 a capsule brought dust from asteroid Bennu to Utah. Inside: all five letters of the genetic code, most of life's amino acids, and dust older than the Sun.

title: The Double-Slit Experiment | BONES
label: Science exhibit · Light
desc: Fire photons through two slits one at a time. Each lands at one random spot, and the fringes only appear in the statistics.

title: The Time Well | BONES
label: Science exhibit · Relativity
desc: Mass slows down time near it, and so does moving fast. The effects are real, atomic clocks have measured them, and they are very, very small.

title: Single Atom in an Ion Trap | BONES
label: Science exhibit · Atoms
desc: An interactive model of David Nadlinger's 2018 photo of a single atom held in an ion trap. Dive from the lab bench down to the atom.
